newsitem.title: USA: Freeport-McMoRan Copper says income more than double.
newsitem.headline: Freeport-McMoRan Copper says income more than double.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc. said Tuesday its second-quarter earnings were more than double its year-earlier profits, helped by strong results at P.T. Freeport Indonesia Co., its main mining unit.
The giant mining company earned $69.8 million, or 35 cents a share, vs. earnings of $29.0 million, or 15 cents a share, in the second quarter of 1996.
Revenues jumped to $566.9 million from $424.3 million.
Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold's stock was up 19 cents at $27.81 in consolidated early afternoon New York Stock Exchange trading.

The company said P.T. Freeport Indonesia had record average mill production of 130,800 metric tons of ore per day during the second quarter and sales of 305.9 million pounds of copper and 431,700 ounces of gold.
Higher copper prices also boosted its earnings, it said.
